import unittest
from datetime import date

class SmokeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_colon_password(self):
        from mailroom import colon_password as core
        self.assertEqual(core.parse_basic_credentials("Basic dTpw"),("u","p"))

    def test_folded_header_spacing(self):
        from mailroom import folded_header_spacing as core
        self.assertEqual(core.unfold_header(["Subject: hello"]),"Subject: hello")

    def test_reply_subject_preservation(self):
        from mailroom import reply_subject_preservation as core
        from mailroom import reply_subject_preservation_api as api
        self.assertEqual(api.subject_for_reply("Hello"),"Re: Hello")

    def test_utf8_header_word(self):
        from mailroom import utf8_header_word as core
        from mailroom import utf8_header_word_api as api
        self.assertEqual(api.subject_header("hello"),"hello")

    def test_quoted_display_backslash(self):
        from mailroom import quoted_display_backslash as core
        self.assertEqual(core.quote_display_name("Ada"),'"Ada"')
